items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I'll play along Armstrong style, but like Big Bud and Eggman, I might touch on one or two of his licks.

ctx.x: Oh, back to this business about copying and all that and saying different things. How do you develop your own ideas? Because I know some of your licks are original and all that.

That's a funny thing. I don't know Dick. It's spontaneous the first time. And if it records on your brain, you probably get it a second time. And it's hard to tell because you can't play anything. In other words, I'll play along Armstrong style, but like Big Bud and Eggman, I might touch on one or two of his licks. But don't forget I'm playing about three choruses and there's what, 32 measures to a chorus and I'm not hitting him note for note. And like you say, I got my own licks in there. I don't know. I try to…
